request.style: English, solo male country voice, acoustic guitar, fiddle, upright bass, light percussion, melancholic mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I hate I despise your festivals
Your solemn assemblies bring no delight
Your burnt offerings I will not accept
Your grain offerings give me no pleasure
Take away from me the noise of your songs
I will not listen to the music of your harps
But let justice roll on like water
And righteousness like an ever-flowing stream

[Chorus]
You carried Sikkuth your king
And Kiyyun your images of the star
The star of your god you made for yourselves
And I will send you into exile beyond Damascus
Says the LORD whose name is the God of hosts

[Verse]
Did you bring me sacrifices and offerings
Those forty years in the wilderness house of Israel
You carried Sikkuth your king again
And Kiyyun your images you made to worship
You turned away to the host of heaven
Carrying the tent of Molech in your hands
The star of the god Rephan you followed
Your idols of wood and stone you served

[Chorus]
You carried Sikkuth your king
And Kiyyun your images of the star
The star of your god you made for yourselves
And I will send you into exile beyond Damascus
Says the LORD whose name is the God of hosts

[Bridge]
So I will send you into exile beyond Babylon
Because you worshiped what your hands made
Your festivals are noise in my ear
Your songs are silence to my heart

[Chorus]
You carried Sikkuth your king
And Kiyyun your images of the star
The star of your god you made for yourselves
And I will send you into exile beyond Damascus
Says the LORD whose name is the God of hosts

[Outro]
Justice rolls like water now
Righteousness flows like a stream
